notes: Identity assessment: supplied canonical text is a full primary research article titled The Anchoring-and-Adjustment Heuristic: Why the Adjustments Are Insufficient, by Nicholas Epley and Thomas Gilovich, Psychological Science volume 17 number 4, printed pages 311–318. Title, authors, year in copyright, journal and page range match the neutral original reference. DOI is not visibly printed in this text, so exact DOI identity is not independently confirmed. Text contains methods, results, tables, discussion and references rather than an abstract-only excerpt. No PDF path supplied; no PDF acquired or rendered. Canonical parse retains OCR/glyph limitations (equality signs appear as 5 and eta-squared-like label as Z2). Input locator p. 7 is not where the numerical results occur: results are printed p.316, sixth article page.
